newsitem.title: USA: Indiana Energy aims for 10 pct growth in EPS.
newsitem.headline: Indiana Energy aims for 10 pct growth in EPS.

text.p: Indiana Energy Inc said Thursday it is aiming for a 10 percent annual growth rate in earnings per share during the next five years.

In a statement highlighting the company's presentation to securities analysts today, Indiana Energy said it would need its unregulated units to contribute about 20 percent or more to its total annual earnings during the next five years to accomplish its goal.
It also said its Indiana Gas unit will seek to grow earnings contributions by about 5 percent through use of a shared services company and aggressive cost control.

The company said that to acheive its goals, ProLiance Energy LLC, a joint venture between Indiana Energy and Citizens Gas and Coke Utility in Indianapolis, will expand its customer base and its products to include power marketing.
Indiana Energy also said it will create, acquire or ally with unregulated businesses as new and existing markets present opportunities.
